sentences.text: 与商业银行不同，中央银行垄断着扩大基础货币的权力。
sentences.evidence: In contrast to a commercial bank, a central bank possesses a monopoly on increasing the monetary base.

sentences.text: 一战后，英美两国央行领导人蒙塔古·诺曼与本杰明·斯特朗就中央银行的定义达成一致。
sentences.evidence: In the aftermath of World War I, leading central bankers of the United Kingdom and the United States respectively, Montagu Norman and Benjamin Strong, agreed on a definition of central banks

sentences.text: 中央银行作为独立于其他银行的类别是逐步形成的，直到20世纪才完全成形。
sentences.evidence: The notion of central banks as a separate category from other banks has emerged gradually, and only fully coalesced in the 20th century.
